summary.zh: 更名后首个带全新品牌图标的完整发布：星球与轨道意象，轨刃在星球上划出 S 形切口，寓意连接多模型平台与自由切换。桌面端十档 icns、网页 favicon、侧边栏 Logo 与引导页品牌图全面换新，并修复更名后 favicon 与侧边栏 Logo 404 的问题。
summary.en: The first complete release carrying the brand-new ModelSwap icon: a planet-and-orbit motif whose blade sweeps an S-shaped cut across the sphere. The full icns set, web favicon, sidebar logo, and onboarding brand art are all refreshed, and the favicon/sidebar 404 left over from the rename is fixed.

highlights.zh: 全新应用图标（星球与轨道，浅色版）：Dock、访达、Cmd-Tab 与安装包全面换新。
highlights.en: New app icon (planet & orbit, light variant): refreshed across the Dock, Finder, Cmd-Tab, and the installers.

highlights.zh: 图标系统覆盖全部触点：桌面端十档尺寸 icns、网页 favicon、apple-touch-icon、侧边栏 Logo 与引导页品牌图统一换新。
highlights.en: The icon system now covers every touchpoint: ten-step desktop icns, web favicon, apple-touch-icon, sidebar logo, and onboarding brand art are all unified.

highlights.zh: 修复更名遗留问题：网页 favicon 与侧边栏 Logo 引用的图标文件缺失导致 404，现已恢复显示。
highlights.en: Fix a rename leftover: the favicon and sidebar logo referenced missing icon files and rendered blank; both are restored.
